title: Seat Switch Open — Start Blocked
shortDescription: The seat presence switch is open, preventing engine start.
fullDescription:
John Deere Z300/Z500/Z700 series zero-turns use the Smart Connect display, which posts service codes prefixed SC. SC001 means the seat operator-present switch is open — either no one is seated, or the switch/harness is faulty. Until the circuit closes, the ECU prevents the starter from engaging.

Over 80% of SC001 events are caused by harness issues rather than a genuinely failed switch. Inspect under-seat routing carefully.

causes.cause: Seat mount loose — plunger not depressed

fixSteps.title: Check connector
fixSteps.instruction: Lift seat, reseat the 2-pin harness connector, confirm it clicks fully home.

fixSteps.title: Tighten seat mounting
fixSteps.instruction: Retorque seat bolts to 20 Nm so the switch plunger is depressed when seated.

fixSteps.title: Replace switch
fixSteps.instruction: If continuity fails, install OEM seat switch GY20073 or AM136400 per model.

whenToCallPro: If SC001 continues after switch replacement, a dealer needs to check the TCU wiring.
videoSearchQuery: John Deere SC001 seat switch Z540M

faq.q: Can I override the seat switch?
faq.a: No — it is part of the legally required operator presence safety system.

title: PTO Switch Circuit Fault
shortDescription: The PTO switch signal is invalid or blade engagement has been blocked.
fullDescription:
SC002 is logged when the PTO switch reads an ambiguous state — both positions active, or neither — or when the PTO clutch draws abnormal current. The fault is most often the switch itself, which lives in a harsh environment under the dash cover.

Secondary causes include water ingress and a corroded PTO clutch connector behind the engine.

fixSteps.title: Inspect connector
fixSteps.instruction: Disconnect PTO clutch connector near engine, dry, clean with contact cleaner.

fixSteps.title: Measure clutch resistance
fixSteps.instruction: Clutch coil should read 2.4-3.0 Ω. Out of range = failed clutch.

fixSteps.title: Replace switch or clutch
fixSteps.instruction: Install OEM component and cycle ignition to clear fault.

whenToCallPro: PTO clutch replacement requires crankshaft pulley removal — many owners prefer dealer service.

faq.q: Can I test the clutch with a battery?
faq.a: Yes — 12 V direct to the clutch coil should engage it with a firm clunk. Absence = bad clutch.

title: Battery Voltage Out of Range
shortDescription: Battery voltage too high or too low — charging system fault suspected.
fullDescription:
SC004 is the catch-all for electrical system faults outside 11.0-15.2 V with the engine running. Over-voltage (>15.2 V) is usually a failed regulator; under-voltage is a depleted battery or stator not charging.

Chronically undercharged batteries fail within one season. Always test the charging system when replacing the battery.

fixSteps.title: Measure static voltage
fixSteps.instruction: Key off — a healthy battery reads 12.6 V. Below 12.3 V = needs charge/replacement.

fixSteps.title: Measure charging voltage
fixSteps.instruction: Engine at 3/4 throttle — should read 13.8-14.6 V across battery.

fixSteps.title: Replace component
fixSteps.instruction: If charging output is low, replace regulator; if stator AC output under 28 V AC, replace stator.

whenToCallPro: Stator replacement requires engine disassembly — dealer service recommended.

faq.a: Borderline — it will eventually undercharge the battery. 13.8 V or higher is healthy.

title: Hydraulic Oil Temperature High
shortDescription: Hydro transmission oil exceeded 240°F — operation reduced to protect pumps.
fullDescription:
John Deere commercial Z-series mowers equipped with Hydro-Gear ZT-5400 or Parker HTJ transmissions monitor oil temperature. SC008 is a warning that oil exceeded 240°F (116°C). Prolonged operation shortens pump life dramatically.

Causes include plugged cooling fins on transmissions, old/degraded oil, or overloading on steep grades.

causes.cause: Over-loaded on steep slopes / heavy grass

symptoms: Loss of ground speed after 20 minutes of use

fixSteps.title: Clear cooling fins
fixSteps.instruction: Let mower cool, then blow out debris from transmission cooling fins with compressed air.

fixSteps.title: Check oil level
fixSteps.instruction: Top off hydro reservoir with 20W-50 synthetic per John Deere spec.

fixSteps.title: Service hydro oil
fixSteps.instruction: If oil is dark or past 400-hour interval, drain and replace with new oil and filter.

whenToCallPro: If oil is clean and fins are clear but temperature still climbs, the pumps may be worn — have dealer test flow.
videoSearchQuery: John Deere Z930M hydro oil change SC008

faq.q: How often should hydro oil be changed?
faq.a: Every 400 hours or annually on commercial Z-series.

title: Engine Will Not Start — Fuel Delivery
shortDescription: Engine cranks but will not start. Diagnostic points to fuel delivery.
fullDescription:
SC010 is thrown when the ECU detects 3+ failed start attempts with healthy spark and correct crank RPM. It is a software prompt to check fuel: tank level, fuel filter, fuel pump pressure, and carburetor or EFI operation.

Ethanol-gasoline phase separation during storage is the #1 cause of SC010 in spring.

fixSteps.title: Drain old fuel
fixSteps.instruction: Siphon tank, replace with fresh non-ethanol if possible, and add stabilizer.

fixSteps.title: Replace fuel filter
fixSteps.instruction: Install new inline filter with flow arrow toward engine.

fixSteps.title: Check fuel pump
fixSteps.instruction: Disconnect line at carb, bag it, crank engine — should squirt each revolution.

whenToCallPro: If fuel delivery is confirmed good and SC010 persists, dealer service is needed to inspect the EFI injectors or carb.
videoSearchQuery: John Deere SC010 fuel delivery fix

faq.a: Yes, but drain the tank for storage — ethanol absorbs water and separates over time.

title: Ignition Timing Fault
shortDescription: Crank trigger signal abnormal — possible sheared flywheel key or sensor fault.
fullDescription:
SC012 indicates the ignition trigger signal is arriving at the wrong crank angle. Causes include a sheared flywheel key (common after striking an object with a blade), a failed crank position sensor, or a cracked trigger tooth on the flywheel.

Do not attempt to run the engine with SC012 active — severe piston damage can result.
symptoms: Engine backfires through carb or exhaust

fixSteps.title: Stop cranking
fixSteps.instruction: Further cranking can bend valves — remove the key.

fixSteps.title: Remove blower housing
fixSteps.instruction: Expose flywheel, remove flywheel nut, use puller.

fixSteps.title: Replace key and torque
fixSteps.instruction: Install new woodruff key, torque flywheel nut to 80 Nm per engine spec.

whenToCallPro: If you lack a flywheel puller and torque wrench, take it to a dealer — incorrect torque will destroy the flywheel.
videoSearchQuery: John Deere flywheel key sheared SC012

faq.a: Almost always because the blade hit a rock or stump — the key is sacrificial to protect the crankshaft.

title: Air Filter Restriction
shortDescription: Intake vacuum is abnormally high — air filter service is due.
fullDescription:
Commercial Z-series models monitor intake vacuum and warn with SC015 when the filter approaches end-of-life. Running with a plugged filter enriches the mixture, fouls plugs, and cuts power by up to 20%.

Most failures are due to owners skipping scheduled service during dusty mowing seasons.

fixSteps.title: Remove and inspect
fixSteps.instruction: Remove the filter cover, tap filter gently — if light passes through unevenly, replace.

fixSteps.title: Install new filter
fixSteps.instruction: Fit OEM paper element and fresh pre-cleaner foam — do not oil the foam on Kawasaki engines.

fixSteps.title: Reset code
fixSteps.instruction: Cycle ignition — SC015 clears when vacuum returns to normal.

whenToCallPro: Rarely needed — this is a routine service item.
videoSearchQuery: John Deere air filter replace Z930M

faq.q: Can I wash the paper filter?
faq.a: No — paper is damaged by water. Tap gently or replace.

title: Blade Engagement Interlock Fault
shortDescription: PTO engagement attempted under unsafe condition — seat, reverse, or deck position.
fullDescription:
The ECU blocks PTO engagement when the operator is not seated, reverse mowing is not authorized, or the deck height lever is at transport (highest) position. SC017 flags that the attempted engagement was refused.

It's usually operator error, but a failed position sensor can also produce it intermittently.

causes.cause: Operator not seated at time of PTO pull

fixSteps.title: Sit firmly
fixSteps.instruction: Ensure full weight is on the seat.

fixSteps.title: Lower deck
fixSteps.instruction: Move deck height lever out of transport position to a cut setting.

fixSteps.title: Enable reverse mow if needed
fixSteps.instruction: Hold the RIO button while engaging PTO in reverse per the operator's manual.

whenToCallPro: Only if a sensor is confirmed faulty by a dealer Service ADVISOR session.

faq.a: Reverse Implement Option — allows mowing in reverse after the operator confirms with the RIO button.

title: Transmission Neutral Not Detected
shortDescription: Steering levers not in the neutral (outward) lock position — engine start blocked.
fullDescription:
Both steering levers must be pushed outward into the neutral park detent for starting. SC020 results when one or both are not detected — usually due to linkage wear letting the switch miss its striker.

Adjustment is straightforward but requires correct sequencing per the service manual.
symptoms: Problem comes and goes with bump

fixSteps.title: Push levers fully outward
fixSteps.instruction: Confirm both steering arms latch into the neutral-park position.

fixSteps.title: Adjust strikers
fixSteps.instruction: Loosen switch mounting screws, position switch so plunger is fully depressed in park, retighten.

fixSteps.title: Replace switch if needed
fixSteps.instruction: Install OEM switch and verify continuity.

whenToCallPro: Dealer service if adjustment fails to resolve after switch replacement.
videoSearchQuery: John Deere neutral switch SC020 adjust

faq.q: Why won't mine start even with brakes on?
faq.a: John Deere zero-turns do not use a traditional parking brake for start — they use the outward steering lever position as neutral.

title: Electric Start Solenoid Failure
shortDescription: Starter solenoid not engaging — clicking but no crank.
fullDescription:
SC025 covers starter motor circuit issues. Most often it is the solenoid on the starter itself — a heavy duty relay whose contacts erode after 500-1000 start cycles. Less commonly it is a bad battery cable, discharged battery, or seized starter.

The telltale is a loud single click followed by silence when the key is turned.

fixSteps.title: Clean battery cables
fixSteps.instruction: Disconnect, wire-brush, reinstall, and torque to spec.

fixSteps.title: Voltage drop test
fixSteps.instruction: Measure voltage drop across battery cable during crank — should be <0.3 V.

fixSteps.title: Replace starter/solenoid
fixSteps.instruction: Remove starter, rebuild or replace as assembly per engine service manual.

whenToCallPro: If crank is intermittent and cables test good, dealer can bench-test the starter.

faq.q: Can I replace just the solenoid?
faq.a: On most JD applications the starter comes as a unit. Some models allow solenoid-only service.
